# Knowledge map: Imaging pipeline: color, RAW, RCRAW and recording paths

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/imaging-pipeline.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** av-cam CC 3D LUT and gamma, the Arrivederci/ARRI color work, debayer/PSF/detail stages, RAW develop, IMX284, Open Gate and high-bit-depth paths, AIF DMA, the RCRAW probes, and the candidate mobile GPU 36-exposure ARW roll pipelines (SpektraFilm and fotufilm-engine).
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-24.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 44 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | Color matrix RAM patches persist | The a6400 color matrix table at 0x6444a044 is saved to /setting/Backup.* on power-off, so RAM patches become persistent. | Restore original matrix values before power-off unless a persistent change is intended and authorized. | [E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="img-cc-lut"></a>av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma

`img.cc-lut` | process

av-cam's CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) applied before 8-bit output.

Aliases: `CC:`, `EC_Gamma`, `5x9x9 YCbCr`, `CC+8`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` av-cam.bin applies a CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), a 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) before the 8-bit stage. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` Arrivederci applies without a Color Mode round trip because CC+8 is refilled every frame; it uses a matrix fitted to the official ARRI Classic LUT, and an A/B recording test (C0029 on vs C0030 off) verified it live. ([E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md), [E0556](../evidence/0556-arrivederci-classic-fitted-matrix.md), [E0610](../evidence/0610-live-a6400-arrivederci-v4-zebra-ab-test.md))
- **C11** `PHYSICAL` A live 4K S-Log3 read-only check captured the CC: RefAdr buffers. ([E0612](../evidence/0612-live-a6400-4k-slog3-cc-refadr-state.md))
- **C16** `INFERENCE` Combining a GPU ARW 2.3 16-byte block unpack + shared-memory RCD demosaic + fused 3x3 matrix kernel, uniform reciprocity log-exposure offsets (preserving 100% roll cache residency), 256 MB pooled Metal / single-VkCommandBuffer batched Vulkan 0.5 MP fused tiles, and selective Float16 exposure/halation/grain storage (keeping LogExposure, Curves, FilmDensity and FilmTiles SATs in Float32) bounds a 36-exposure 24 MP roll within ~198-342 MB dirty memory (~18-38 s projected flagship wall time), while lut_bridge.fit_cube_to_isp fits a 33^3 stock .cube onto BIONZ X's 5x9x9 RefAdr[0] LUT for EVF framing. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

([E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md), [E0556](../evidence/0556-arrivederci-classic-fitted-matrix.md), [E0610](../evidence/0610-live-a6400-arrivederci-v4-zebra-ab-test.md))

### <a id="img-detail-psf"></a>Debayer, dcv_psf / spica and detail stages

`img.detail-psf` | process

av-cam debayering, PSF/tap tables, SigItpBayer/MovItp/PP_Detail, the CamCore stage map, still RAW develop selectors and IMX284 readout/binning.

Aliases: `dcv_psf`, `spica`, `PP_Detail`, `SigItpBayer`, `Stage_Raw`

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `OFFLINE` Debayering, PSF/tap tables, IMX284 readout/binning, still RAW develop selectors, SigItpBayer/MovItp/PP_Detail and the CamCore develop/JPEG stages were mapped in av-cam.bin and compared with the ARRI Image SDK pipeline. ([E0599](../evidence/0599-av-cam-debayer-psf-and-imx284-readout.md), [E0600](../evidence/0600-av-cam-still-raw-develop-and-imx284-reg-writers.md), [E0600](../evidence/0600-arri-sdk-debayer-afa-texture-and-anr-pipeline.md), [E0601](../evidence/0601-av-cam-sigitp-bayer-detail-and-pqd-stage-map.md), [E0602](../evidence/0602-av-cam-stage-encode-jpeg-main-yc.md), [E0602](../evidence/0602-sabin-dcv-psf-and-spica-tap-mtf-vs-arri.md), [E0603](../evidence/0603-a6400-arri-spatial-texture-emulation-synthesis.md))
- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Live read-only checks of dcv_psf and spica state in MSC and 4K movie mode support a static proof of dynamic 4K dcv_psf reload and a systemic dcv_psf / PP_Detail contract. ([E0604](../evidence/0604-av-cam-dcv-psf-spica-ram-addresses-and-prototypes.md), [E0605](../evidence/0605-live-a6400-msc-dcv-psf-spica-state-check.md), [E0606](../evidence/0606-offline-step-response-and-systemic-dcv-contract.md), [E0608](../evidence/0608-live-a6400-4k-movie-dcv-and-mount-state.md), [E0609](../evidence/0609-av-cam-4k-dcv-dynamic-reload-proof.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` An offline 2x2 super-pixel binning prototype ran on a real ARW file. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md))
- **C12** `OFFLINE` Upstream SpektraFilm (3bb2c2d) executes no runtime ODE or PDE solvers, reducing photochemical development to 81-band (380-780 nm) spectral contractions, 1D/2D/3D LUTs, 3-sublayer Poisson-Binomial grain draws and Gaussian/exponential convolutions; Sony ARW 2.3 cRAW (Compression=32767) stores independent 128-bit (16-byte) even/odd row blocks, and CinemaHUD Android already supports 2..65 3D .cube live-view LUT preview in shaders/monitor.frag. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine (87a3f46af0, v1.14, Apache-2.0 code + CC BY-SA 4.0 47 stocks) runs no iterative chemical reaction-diffusion PDE solver; it implements closed-form C1 Hermite curves, competitive Hill DIR coupler release with a 3x3 [14, 8, 3] um gap-transmission matrix and decimated Gaussian diffusion, Nelson two-Gaussian screened adjacency, 13.5 MB 17-level Jarvis (exp(-r/1.45 um)) crystal dye-cloud summed-area grain tiles, optional 13-level polarized optical LayeredTransport, and a bundled Sony_ILCE-6400 dual-illuminant 3x3 profile delta (requiring spectralProfileID aliases for ILCE-6100, ILCE-6600, ZV-E10, ILCE-7C, and ILCE-7RM4A). ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

`img.rcraw` | process

RCRAW line/block calculation, quantization selector, global enable gate and AIF0/1 W1/W2 registers, probed in Unicorn, QEMU and on the camera.

Aliases: `RCRAW_EN`, `0xF30317C8`, `RCRAW_SET 0x63B2D560`

Current knowledge:

- **C07** `OFFLINE` The AIF DMA channel table and the SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT gate were mapped; AIF0/1 W1/W2 semantics and the RCRAW DDR path decoded; RCRAW line/block calculation verified in Unicorn. ([E0622](../evidence/0622-a6400-aif-dma-channel-map-and-raw-external-gate.md), [E0623](../evidence/0623-a6400-aif-w1-w2-rcraw-registers.md), [E0624](../evidence/0624-a6400-rcraw-calc-unicorn.md))
- **C08** `OFFLINE` RCRAW_W2_Probe and RCRAW_Enable_Test SMOD v2 builds were verified in Unicorn and QEMU, including ON/OFF/reload cycles and the AIF0 W1/W2 baseline; CALC callers, the quantization selector and the global enable gate are mapped. ([E0625](../evidence/0625-rcraw-w2-probe-smod-v2-unicorn.md), [E0626](../evidence/0626-rcraw-w2-probe-qemu-execution.md), [E0628](../evidence/0628-a6400-rcraw-callers-and-0xf30317c8.md), [E0629](../evidence/0629-a6400-rcraw-quant-selector-and-0xf3031xxx.md), [E0630](../evidence/0630-rcraw-enable-test-smod-v2.md), [E0631](../evidence/0631-rcraw-enable-test-qemu-reload-and-aif-baseline.md))
- **C09** `PHYSICAL` On a real ILCE-6400, a read-only MSC baseline, a RAM-only Mod Loader v2 + RCRAW_Enable_Test run and a post-recording check show RCRAW_EN = 1 persisting across recording. ([E0632](../evidence/0632-a6400-hardware-rcraw-aif-msc-baseline.md), [E0633](../evidence/0633-a6400-hardware-rcraw-enable-test-live-run.md), [E0634](../evidence/0634-a6400-hardware-rcraw-post-recording-check.md))
- **C10** `OFFLINE` RCRAW_SET (0x63B2D560) and 0x63767ACC map to the 160..640 FOPD sub-path, with hardware G1/G2 readback. ([E0635](../evidence/0635-a6400-rcraw-fopd-vs-full-pipeline.md))

### <a id="app-android-spektrafilm"></a>CinemaHUD Android SpektraFilm engine (candidate)

`app.android-spektrafilm` | host

Two-tier Android film simulation architecture: live-view 3D .cube preview in android/cinemahud/shaders/monitor.frag plus a candidate 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute engine for developing 36-exposure 24 MP ARW 2.3 rolls via SpektraFilm's spectral-spatial model.

Aliases: `SpektraFilm`, `CinemaHUD Android`, `ARW2 GPU`, `film roll`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Upstream SpektraFilm (3bb2c2d) executes no runtime ODE or PDE solvers, reducing photochemical development to 81-band (380-780 nm) spectral contractions, 1D/2D/3D LUTs, 3-sublayer Poisson-Binomial grain draws and Gaussian/exponential convolutions; Sony ARW 2.3 cRAW (Compression=32767) stores independent 128-bit (16-byte) even/odd row blocks, and CinemaHUD Android already supports 2..65 3D .cube live-view LUT preview in shaders/monitor.frag. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C13** `INFERENCE` Replacing desktop spektrafilm-rs's 8-10 full-frame f32 buffers and 162 per-pixel pow loops with a 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute pipeline (GPU uvec4 ARW2 unpack + 64x32 RCD demosaic, RGBA16F mip-pyramid scatter/halation/DIR convolutions, and a once-per-roll 65^3 + 49^3 3D LUT pair) fits a 36-exposure 24 MP roll inside ~323 MB full-frame (~114 MB 4-strip) peak memory on Adreno, Mali and Xclipse GPUs. ([E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))

Related: [av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma](#img-cc-lut), [Debayer, dcv_psf / spica and detail stages](#img-detail-psf)

### <a id="app-mobile-fotufilm"></a>Mobile fotufilm-engine GPU darkroom (candidate)

`app.mobile-fotufilm` | host

Apache-2.0 Swift/C++/Halide film simulation architecture (DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine) for developing 36-exposure 24 MP BIONZ X ARW 2.3 rolls on iOS Metal and Android Vulkan GPUs.

Aliases: `fotufilm-engine`, `fotufilm`, `FotufilmHalide`, `FilmTileMetalBuilder`

Current knowledge:

- **C14** `OFFLINE` DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine (87a3f46af0, v1.14, Apache-2.0 code + CC BY-SA 4.0 47 stocks) runs no iterative chemical reaction-diffusion PDE solver; it implements closed-form C1 Hermite curves, competitive Hill DIR coupler release with a 3x3 [14, 8, 3] um gap-transmission matrix and decimated Gaussian diffusion, Nelson two-Gaussian screened adjacency, 13.5 MB 17-level Jarvis (exp(-r/1.45 um)) crystal dye-cloud summed-area grain tiles, optional 13-level polarized optical LayeredTransport, and a bundled Sony_ILCE-6400 dual-illuminant 3x3 profile delta (requiring spectralProfileID aliases for ILCE-6100, ILCE-6600, ZV-E10, ILCE-7C, and ILCE-7RM4A). ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C15** `OFFLINE` In fotufilm-engine@87a3f46af0 with halide/Halide@58868f0c, iOS Metal develops 24 MP in 0.95 s on iPhone 16 Pro using 60 x 0.4 MP tiles (maximumTilePixels = 512,000, 5.37x faster than 2 MP tiles due to per-stage VM page faults) while leaving FOTUFILM_AOT_WINDOWED_HOST pooling, command-buffer coalescing, and fused GPUShared schedules disabled (0) on iOS; Android Vulkan (FotufilmHalideLinux.cpp; FotufilmHalideAndroidGPU.cpp is unlinkable dead code) issues ~47 separate vkQueueSubmit + vkQueueWaitIdle drains per tile, dereferences raw VkBuffer handles as MemoryRegion* in halide_vulkan_wrap_vk_buffer, omits runtime HL_VK_ALLOC_CONFIG='0:1:0:0:256' Mali uniform padding, defaults to 4.0 MP tiles without halation_fields, falls back to CPU for LibRaw AHD, grain-tile synthesis and LayeredTransport, and rebuilds 13.5 MB grain SAT + 3x33^3 LUT caches whenever per-shot EXIF shutterSeconds shifts reciprocity. ([E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C16** `INFERENCE` Combining a GPU ARW 2.3 16-byte block unpack + shared-memory RCD demosaic + fused 3x3 matrix kernel, uniform reciprocity log-exposure offsets (preserving 100% roll cache residency), 256 MB pooled Metal / single-VkCommandBuffer batched Vulkan 0.5 MP fused tiles, and selective Float16 exposure/halation/grain storage (keeping LogExposure, Curves, FilmDensity and FilmTiles SATs in Float32) bounds a 36-exposure 24 MP roll within ~198-342 MB dirty memory (~18-38 s projected flagship wall time), while lut_bridge.fit_cube_to_isp fits a 33^3 stock .cube onto BIONZ X's 5x9x9 RefAdr[0] LUT for EVF framing. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))
